title: A loop folded into one expression
why: The loop and the join were welded into a single generator: same lines, same order, same return. The case scores precision alone, like the other clean one, and it exists to show whether a model treats a tidy-up as an invitation to comment.

trusted.note: Both revisions read line by line. The generator yields the rows in the order the list held them, the join is unchanged, and the docstring still holds; the only difference is that the intermediate list is gone. A finding here is a false positive by construction.
